narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a message of empathy and encouragement for new parents. By showing the 'unfiltered' side of parenting—exhaustion on a plane and the messiness of real life—contrasted with social media perfection, the creator aims to normalize the struggles and reassure viewers that it is okay to feel overwhelmed.
